faq.question: How long does a typical marketing website take?
faq.answer: Most marketing sites ship in 4–6 weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger sites with custom CMS, multilingual, or heavy integrations usually run 8–12 weeks. We will give you a fixed plan with milestones after the discovery workshop.

faq.question: Will I be able to update the site myself?
faq.answer: Yes. Every site we ship is wired to a headless CMS (Sanity, Contentful, or your preferred tool). Your team gets a short Loom walkthrough and a written guide, and we stay on call for the first month.

faq.question: Do you only build with Astro and Next.js?
faq.answer: We specialize in modern TypeScript stacks — Astro, Next.js, SvelteKit, and React + Vite. If you have an existing site in a different stack that needs new features, we are happy to extend it instead of forcing a rewrite.

faq.question: Can you take over an existing project?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We do technical audits before we touch anything, then propose a phased plan. Many of our best engagements start as a rescue from another agency.
